evidence.quote: So this morning I would like to do some stocktaking: to review briefly the vulnerabilities in the financial system that contributed to the crisis and compel regulatory response
One obvious example is the housing market, which remains depressed today, although there are at last some signs of gradual improvement.
Two areas where the case for reform in the short-run is compelling are money market funds and the tri-party repo market.

parsed.rationale: The speech concerns financial regulatory reform (too-big-to-fail, capital, liquidity, shadow banking) and takes no view on monetary policy. Its only macro remark is that housing remains depressed, a mild dovish note on activity.
